task.title: Run Red Hat Quay with storage preferences
task.shortdesc: To run a standalone Red Hat Quay instance with a regional storage preference, you can set the QUAY_DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_PREFERENCE environment variable when you start the container.

step.cmd: Copy the config.yaml file to all machines running Red Hat Quay.
For each machine in each region, add a QUAY_DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_PREFERENCE environment variable with the preferred storage engine for the region in which the machine is running.

info.p: For example, for a machine running in Europe with the config directory on the host available from $QUAY/config:

note.p: The value of the environment variable specified must match the name of a Location ID as defined in the config panel.

step.cmd: Restart all Red Hat Quay containers.
